title: Eathon Lambert/Quotes
summary:
"Lok, the most important thing about a puzzle is that it has to be fun."
- Eathon Lambert to a young Lok Lambert (The Beautiful Trap)

"Freedom is the key to everything, Lok. You can't explore without freedom of movement, you can't solve a puzzle without freedom of thought."
- Eathon Lambert to Lok Lambert in a flashback (Like Father, Unlike Son)
full_text:
"Lok, the most important thing about a puzzle is that it has to be fun."
- Eathon Lambert to a young Lok Lambert (The Beautiful Trap)

"Freedom is the key to everything, Lok. You can't explore without freedom of movement, you can't solve a puzzle without freedom of thought."
- Eathon Lambert to Lok Lambert in a flashback (Like Father, Unlike Son)
